[SWS_DM_00963] Configuration of a DTCs failed Operation Cycles Since First
Failed as extended data record
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04190
⌈
If the
DiagnosticExtendedDataRecordElement
is referred by
Di-
agnosticEdrDataProviderMapping.extendedDataRecordElement
and
DiagnosticEdrDataProviderMapping.dataProvider
is set to
DEM_CYCLES_SINCE_FIRST_FAILED
, the DM shall report the internal value of
the current
Operation Cycles Since First Failed Counter
of the contex-
tual DTC in the respective extended data record.
The length of this
internal data element
is one byte.
⌋
